details:
Opening URLs in VR mode shared by other users is unnecessarily difficult.

The current workarounds are (ab)using social links in profile for clickable links, asking a person to repeat that URL in the chatbox several times until it's manually typed by the receiver, taking a photo of the chatbox using a camera with the UI shown, or driving users to an external social platform off from VRChat ("can you add me on Discord?").

This is a proposal to share URLs on droppable pedestals, or send to users an URL link in the instance as a delivered notification.

URLs on pedestals would follow the same as any other pedestals: 90 seconds or until I leave the instance, shared publicly, with friends or with members of a group.

Send to Users would follow the recipient's settings for receiving notifications about shared URLs (defaults to Friends).

This has security considerations regarding untrusted URLs and public instances.

Related: https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/1222-share-url-links-with-chatbox-open-webpage
title: Share URL links with pedestals / send to users? Open webpage?
